segments.contextAfter: `prefsID`: The name of the group of preferences to be accessed or updated. A name that starts with a leading “/” character specifies the absolute path to the file containing the preferences to be accessed. A name that does not start with a leading “/” character specifies a file relative to the default system preferences directory. To access the default system preferences, pass in `NULL`.
